nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) storing token balances; written in transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances; mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Constant public decimals = 18.
Public total token supply, assigned in the constructor.
Public token name, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol, set in the constructor.
Private privileged address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as an access-control guard.
Private address of the derived Uniswap pair, used by calcFee as the fee-triggering recipient.
Constant internal address 0x1691b5bA9E44Fdc0DCA002726a85d438B96183c4 of the external fee library.
Public payable transfer entry point that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom: checks/updates allowance, debits sender balance, calls calcFee, credits recipient and emits Transfer.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of factory, sorted tokens and init code hash.
Private fee computation that makes an external call to the FeeManagement library when _to == UNI and _from != owner.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an address supplied by the caller.
Owner-only bulk transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length and credits each recipient in a loop.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Payable constructor initialising metadata, owner, totalSupply, balances, allowance and the UNI pair address.
Caller-controlled address used for transfer authorisation, allowance keys, owner checks and owner assignment.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): executes arbitrary attacker-supplied bytecode in the token's storage context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (arithmetic risk, pre-0.8 semantics).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without overflow/underflow protection.
balanceOf[_to] += (_value - fee) performed after the external fee call and without SafeMath.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend: multiplication with no overflow guard.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend, unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop, unchecked arithmetic and double Transfer event emission.
FeeManagementLibrary(FeeManagement).calculate(address(this), UNI, _value) external call made before balanceOf[_to] is credited.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit _from when transfer() forwards to transferFrom.
transfer() immediately invokes transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the allowance spender key in transferFrom.
require(msg.sender == owner) guards the privileged delegate() function.
require(msg.sender == owner) guards the privileged batchSend() function.
msg.sender is the owner key of allowance[msg.sender][_spender] in approve().
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting permanent privileged control.
delegate() performs an unrestricted delegatecall to the caller-supplied address a.
Arbitrary delegatecall bytecode executes in the token context and can re-enter transferFrom.
transferFrom calls calcFee between debiting _from and crediting _to, creating a reentrancy window.
calcFee invokes the external FeeManagement library before balances are finalised.
The external fee library call can re-enter transferFrom before balanceOf[_to] is credited.
The FeeManagement constant address is the target of the external calculate() call.
transferFrom subtracts _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from].
transferFrom credits balanceOf[_to] with _value minus the fee.
_value flows into the unchecked allowance subtraction.
_value flows into the unchecked balance subtraction.
_value (minus fee) flows into the unchecked balance credit.
_to is the recipient key used when crediting balanceOf[_to].
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with no overflow protection.
_value is multiplied by the recipient array length.
_tos.length is multiplied by _value, allowing overflow via a large array.
The local total is the potentially overflowing product.
The overflowing total is subtracted from the sender balance.
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] by total.
batchSend credits each recipient inside the loop.
The loop-local _to is the key written in balanceOf[_to].
Loop counter i drives the batchSend iteration.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
The constructor initialises balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
calcFee compares _from against the owner state variable.
calcFee compares _to against the UNI pair state variable.
The constructor assigns totalSupply from _totalSupply.
The constructor calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address.
The constructor writes the owner state variable.
_to parameter is forwarded by transfer to transferFrom.
_value parameter is forwarded by transfer to transferFrom.
_to is the recipient key in transferFrom.
_value is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
_from is the source key for allowance and balance reads/writes.
factory parameter feeds the keccak256 pair address derivation.
tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
token0 local is used in the pair hash.
token1 local is used in the pair hash.
pair local is the returned pair address.
_from parameter is compared against owner in calcFee.
_to parameter is compared against UNI in calcFee.
_value parameter is forwarded to the fee library call.
fee local holds calcFee's return value.
The external library return value becomes the fee used in the unchecked balance credit.
Parameter a is the attacker-controllable delegatecall target.
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata passed to delegatecall.
Parameter a reaches the delegatecall inside delegate().
Parameter b reaches the delegatecall inside delegate().
_spender is the spender key written by approve.
_value is the allowance amount written by approve.
_name parameter assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
_totalSupply parameter assigned to totalSupply and balanceOf[msg.sender].

Parameter _value of transfer() is only an argument carrier and merges into the transfer function node.
_from is a direct argument of transferFrom and merges into that function node.
_to is a direct argument of transferFrom and merges into that function node.
_value is a direct argument of transferFrom and merges into that function node.
factory is only used inside pairFor and merges into that function node.
tokenA is only used inside pairFor and merges into that function node.
tokenB is only used inside pairFor and merges into that function node.
token0 is a transient local of pairFor and merges into that function node.
token1 is a transient local of pairFor and merges into that function node.
pair is the return local of pairFor and merges into that function node.
_from is only used for the owner comparison inside calcFee and merges into that function node.
_to is only used for the UNI comparison inside calcFee and merges into that function node.
_value is only forwarded to the fee library inside calcFee and merges into that function node.
